name: Island coalescence
blurb: Two magnetic islands in a current sheet (the Fadeev equilibrium), pushed together: like parallel currents they attract, squeeze a current sheet between them, and merge through it into one island at a rate the resistivity sets (Finn & Kaw 1977). The reconnection setups follow the taranis WebGPU reduced-MHD page of Mallet & Abraham (alfredmallet.github.io/taranis/webgpu/rmhd2d.html).
